run_evaluate_location: run the evaluate script to test tourist-guide navigation models on train, valid, and test datasets
run_evaluate_continuous: run the evaluate script with continuous communication channel between tourist and guide models
run_evaluate_discrete: run the evaluate script with discrete communication channel between tourist and guide models
run_evaluate_natural: run the evaluate script with natural language communication and a specified decoding strategy
run_evaluate_gpu: run the evaluate script on GPU with cuda enabled for faster model inference
